answer: Since the garden hash is stored at intake, the mirror graph groups the endorsements and the pearl audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 134 aliases as a result pays for 134 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
